fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The service this account calls through.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off, a call is never placed through this account.

fields.label: Provider Credentials (outbound — the CRM calls the provider)
API Key
fields.description: The provider's API key. Held on the server only.

fields.label: From Number (optional)
fields.description: The number the provider calls from, in full international form, e.g. +919876543210. Optional.

fields.label: Inbound Webhook (the provider calls the CRM)
Webhook Token
fields.description: Generate one, save, then register the copied URL with the provider. It proves the caller is the provider. Blank means call outcomes cannot be reported back.

fields.label: Previous Webhook Token
fields.description: Set while a token is being replaced. Both work until this is cleared, so no outcome is rejected mid-change.

fields.label: Authentication
fields.description: The token is always required. Add signature checking only for a provider that signs what it sends, which Bolna does not.

fields.label: HMAC Signing Secret
fields.description: The shared secret the provider signs with.

fields.label: Signature Header
fields.description: The header carrying the signature, e.g. X-Signature.

fields.label: Signature Algorithm
fields.description: The hash the provider signs with.

fields.label: Signature Encoding
fields.description: The encoding the provider uses for the signature it sends.

fields.label: Signature Prefix
fields.description: Removed before the signature is compared, e.g. sha256=. Blank when the provider sends a bare signature.

fields.label: Enforce IP Allowlist
fields.description: Reject any call outcome not sent from an address listed below. Leave it off unless the provider publishes fixed addresses. It cannot be turned on while the list is empty.

fields.label: Allowed Addresses
fields.description: One address or range per line, e.g. 13.234.10.5 or 13.234.0.0/16. Read only when the setting above is ticked.
